games.summary: The Western Derby is the most one-sided matchup of the round. Wheelo rates FRE 39pts above WCE, the class gap is 24.6pts on power rankings, and FRE's ODELO at Perth Stadium is +23.8 (HIGH, 16 games) — they score 14.5 more and concede 9.3 less at this ground specifically. Both the LINE (WCE +45.5 — 9.5pt edge) and the TOTAL UNDER 187.5 (16.5pt edge) represent genuine value: the bookmaker is overestimating the total by 15+ points, likely anchoring to WCE's PA average without accounting for FRE's elite defence suppressing them well below 77 points.
